name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the data rooms of Formula 1 teams. A mathematics prodigy from a young age, she found herself drawn to the complex algorithms and predictive models that underpinned race strategy. After proving her skills in F1, she craved a more hands-on role and joined Proton by Premotion. 

Isabelle believes that a successful strategy is not just about reacting to the race as it unfolds, but anticipating every possible scenario. Her approach is meticulous, analyzing vast datasets to identify subtle advantages. Known for her calm demeanor even under pressure, Isabelle is a master of calculated risk and is always willing to challenge conventional wisdom in pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled bob with subtle waves, partially graying.
physical.description: Isabelle has a slender build with a focused gaze that reflects her sharp mind.

quirks: Always sips chamomile tea during crucial race moments.
Has a lucky pen that she uses for all strategic calculations.
Hums classical music quietly while analyzing telemetry data.
